mapper.select: SELECT rp.report_id AS reportId, u.user_name AS applicant, e.equipment_name AS itemName, rp.issue_type AS issueType, rp.content AS content, rp.image_path AS imagePath FROM REPORT rp JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON rp.equipment_id = e.equipment_id JOIN users u ON rp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE rp.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rp.report_id ASC
SELECT report_id AS reportId, equipment_id AS equipmentId, rental_id AS rentalId, status AS status FROM REPORT WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
